{"target_smiles":"COCc1cccnc1N1CCN(C[C@H]2COc3ccccc3O2)CC1","routes":[{"strategy_plan":"本路线采用高度汇聚的合成策略，关键切断为目标分子中哌嗪侧链氮原子与手性1,4-苯并二氧杂环片段之间的碳氮键，通过亲核取代烷基化反应完成分子的最终装配。合成拆分为两个主要片段：含吡啶的哌嗪砌块与手性苯并二氧杂环磺酸酯。对于吡啶哌嗪片段，从廉价易得的2-氯烟酸甲酯出发，经还原为醇、甲基化引入甲氧基后，通过芳香亲核取代（SNAr）与哌嗪偶联得到；手性苯并二氧杂环片段则由邻苯二酚与手性(S)-环氧氯丙烷发生双重亲核环化构建手性中心并形成六元杂环，随后进行磺酰化活化。该路线避免了繁琐的保护基操作，各步反应选择性高且立体构型传递明确。","key_disconnection_class":"Nucleophilic substitution","disconnection_type":"coupling","planned_num_steps":6,"strategy":"汇聚式烷基化连接杂环与手性苯并二氧杂环","route_id":1,"steps":[{"step_id":1,"product":"COCc1cccnc1N1CCN(C[C@H]2COc3ccccc3O2)CC1","precursors":["COCc1cccnc1N1CCNCC1","Cc1ccc(S(=O)(=O)OC[C@H]2COc3ccccc3O2)cc1"],"reaction_class":"Nucleophilic substitution"},{"step_id":2,"product":"COCc1cccnc1N1CCNCC1","precursors":["COCc1cccnc1Cl","C1CNCCN1"],"reaction_class":"Nucleophilic aromatic substitution"},{"step_id":3,"product":"COCc1cccnc1Cl","precursors":["OCc1cccnc1Cl","CI"],"reaction_class":"Williamson ether synthesis"},{"step_id":4,"product":"OCc1cccnc1Cl","precursors":["COC(=O)c1cccnc1Cl","[AlH4-].[Li+]"],"reaction_class":"Ester reduction"},{"step_id":5,"product":"Cc1ccc(S(=O)(=O)OC[C@H]2COc3ccccc3O2)cc1","precursors":["OC[C@H]1COc2ccccc2O1","Cc1ccc(S(=O)(=O)Cl)cc1"],"reaction_class":"Sulfonylation"},{"step_id":6,"product":"OC[C@H]1COc2ccccc2O1","precursors":["Oc1ccccc1O","ClC[C@H]1CO1"],"reaction_class":"Heterocycle synthesis"}],"starting_materials":["C1CNCCN1","CI","COC(=O)c1cccnc1Cl","Cc1ccc(S(=O)(=O)Cl)cc1","ClC[C@H]1CO1","Oc1ccccc1O","[AlH4-].[Li+]"]}]}
